notes: *also* rests on the waw of וּבֵרַךְ under rule 51; a waw is present, so the postposed position is discontinuity rather than evidence of an added word.
*new wine* heads on *wine* because rule 31's subtraction is asymmetric here — *new* alone names nothing — which is the same test that heads *graven images* on *graven* elsewhere in the chapter.
The final dative לְ is unrepresented (bare English indirect object, rule 40) while its suffix takes *thee*.
